# launchOS

launchOS is an AI-powered startup engine that turns a raw idea into a complete launch plan in minutes.
Built for Indian founders. Used by 2,847+ founders, rated 4.9/5 (127 reviews).

## What it does
- Niche analysis
- Market validation
- MVP planning
- Pricing strategy
- Outreach planning
